title: prioritize team over victory
context: A rival's pressure puts a teammate at risk.
observed_actions: Chooses surrender to protect a teammate and retain the group's trust.
observed_result: Team loses the immediate game but preserves an important relationship.
epistemic_limits: Does not prove he would surrender under every threat.
information_available: A rival's pressure puts a teammate at risk.
counterfactual_test: A captain can concede a contest to prevent a teammate's serious loss. Balances group welfare and legitimacy against victory. Does not prove he would surrender under every threat.
